instructions: Execute the scripts/list-jobs.mjs script from the project root.
Use: node .codex/skills/graph-engineering/scripts/list-jobs.mjs
You MUST match the user's request against the discovered jobs and determine whether a single job can be selected.

READ_JOB_INPUTS.condition: A single matching job logical identifier is clearly identified

PRESENT_JOBS.condition: The user did not provide a job name

NOT_FOUND.condition: The user provided a job name, but no available job matches it

AMBIGUOUS.condition: More than one discovered job matches the requested job name or the same logical identifier appears more than once

ERROR.condition: An error occurred while resolving the user's request

instructions: You MUST include every job exactly once; no job MAY be omitted, summarized, truncated, or replaced with phrases.
You MUST preserve each job's group name and logical identifier.
You MUST use the following format:
# Available Jobs:
- **(<group-name>)**: `<job-name>`, ... , `<job-name>`
- **(<group-name>)**: `<job-name>`, ... , `<job-name>`
- **Others**: `<job-name>`, ... , `<job-name>`
You MUST stop execution and ask which job they want to execute.

RESOLVE_REQUEST.condition: The user provides a job name

ERROR.condition: An error occurred while presenting the available jobs

instructions: Execute the scripts/read_job_inputs.py from the project root using only the selected job logical identifier.
Use: python3 execute-job/scripts/read_job_inputs.py <job-name>

ERROR.condition: Failed to read job definition from disk

instructions: You MUST inspect the extracted '## Inputs' section and verify whether all mandatory inputs defined there are available in the request or conversation context.
You MUST NOT execute the job process, create repository files, or run job scripts during this state.

READ_JOB_PROCESS.condition: All required execution inputs are present and valid

REQUEST_EXECUTION_INPUT.condition: At least one required execution input is missing

ERROR.condition: An error occurred while validating execution inputs

instructions: You MUST stop execution and ask the user for the missing required execution input(s) explicitly.
You MUST explain what input is needed and why it is required for the job.

VALIDATE_EXECUTION_INPUTS.condition: The user provides the required execution input(s)

ERROR.condition: An error occurred while requesting input

instructions: Execute the scripts/read_job_process.py from the project root using only the selected job logical identifier.
Use: python3 execute-job/scripts/read_job_process.py <job-name>

ERROR.condition: Failed to read job process from disk

instructions: You MUST inspect the extracted '## Process' section and verify that it contains NO references to creating, generating, writing, persisting, or resolving Managed Outputs.
You MUST report the exact lines where you find any prohibited references to Managed Outputs.

SPAWN_JOB.condition: The process is free of Managed Output references

MANAGED_OUTPUT_REFERENCE_FOUND.condition: The process contains a prohibited reference to Managed Outputs

ERROR.condition: An error occurred while validating the job process

instructions: You MUST execute the job process exclusively according to the extracted '## Process' instructions.
You MAY engage in multi-turn conversation, interviews, or interactive steps with the user as required by the job's process.
You MUST preserve the active '<execution-id>' across all intermediate conversational turns.

You MUST NOT resolve, create, or write Managed Output files during this state; upon completing the job process steps, you MUST stop before generating any Managed Output and resume this graph execution.

ERROR.condition: An error occurred during job execution
